name: agent-city
description: A city of agents that builds software end-to-end from one command (/phoenix) — in an existing repo or a completely empty folder. The Mayor orchestrates; the executive agents execute: city-engineer (writes code), city-inspector (writes + runs tests), city-herald (keeps the README + docs in sync with what shipped), city-courier (founds the repo if needed, opens + stewards the GitHub PR), city-archivist (provisions a database when needed). Two agents ride every phase read-only: city-marshal (the police — four deputies covering ethics, licenses/policy, secrets/PII, and data quality, with halt authority) and city-bank (the treasury — advisory-only token-budget watch that never halts or hinders the work). Every run keeps a resumable, reviewer-auditable ledger on the feature branch. The pipeline loops until the pull request passes — and never merges to main.
